name: Pool toolchain probe (pgvector + one tsc per pool project, daily on a pool builder; hub check)

knobs.note: BH-9435: seconds `npm ci --prefer-offline` may take on the fresh clone before the probe's tsc check. Past it the verdict reads tsc=fail:npm-ci-124. Per project: lane.pool-toolchain-probe.<project>.pool_probe_npm_timeout_s.

BH-9435: seconds the probe's `npx tsc --noEmit` may take (the rebase verify's tsc timeout is 900). Past it the verdict reads tsc=fail:124. Per project: lane.pool-toolchain-probe.<project>.pool_probe_tsc_timeout_s.

BH-9435: 1 (the default) = the first pool build of each project per UTC day runs the probe on the pool builder (fly/builder-runner.sh calls --builder after warm-up). 0 = the builder half is off; --check on the hub still reads the ledger. Per project: lane.pool-toolchain-probe.<project>.pool_probe_on_builder.

BH-9435: seconds after which a `running` claim (ledger kind pool-toolchain-probe, key <project>:<YYYY-MM-DD>) with no verdict is taken again by the next pool build: the machine that claimed it died mid-probe. Per project: lane.pool-toolchain-probe.<project>.pool_probe_claim_stale_s.

BH-9435: seconds `pg_ctl -m fast -w -t <s> stop` waits for the probe's postmaster to stop before the single-user CREATE EXTENSION vector check. Past it the verdict reads pg=fail:stop-for-single. Per project: lane.pool-toolchain-probe.<project>.pool_probe_pg_stop_timeout_s.
